name: cs336-compatible-posttraining-v1
authorship: Original Dongxi symbolic fixture; no upstream prose/code copied.

difficulty.name: parent-training-complete-path-probability-v1
difficulty.scope: Select eligible train prompts once from frozen SFT parent; development is a signal audit only. Never use heldout for selection. All eligible groups enter updates; mixed-only filtering is a separately labeled counterfactual population/cost audit.

comparison.coverage: 8 distinct train sources, two templates each
comparison.repetition: 2 distinct train sources (0,0) and (0,1), two templates each repeated four times
comparison.matching: SFT arms match supervised target exposure and optimizer updates; siblings match attempted fresh groups and update caps, not accepted labels or later sampled paths.

interface.name: parity-symbolic-two-token-v1
interface.rl_distribution: conditional position-specific syntax support; EOS is sampled, not forced
interface.supervised_mask: labels first four positions -100; both response tokens supervised after exactly one causal shift
interface.response_mask: generated positions through and including EOS; later PAD excluded

oracle: Parity: exact integer (a+b)%2. Withheld equality: int(a==b). No neural response parsing in task oracle.
hypotheses: Coverage may transfer better than repetition on paired heldout sources; all seeds and negative outcomes retained.
Accepted-response SFT and reward updates can improve termination without learning unseen parity sources.
Inclusive group normalization changes finite-group estimators; mixed filtering changes population and cost.
stop_rules: No heldout recipe selection, cap increase or native/GPU execution. Nonfinite state, interface mismatch, or deadline aborts with failure record. Absent reward signal is a diagnostic, not permission to extend a run.
